limitations: Relation references are discovered by a static scan for schema-qualified FROM, JOIN, UPDATE, INTO, REFERENCES and TRUNCATE tokens. Dynamic SQL, unqualified identifiers, trigger-only dependencies and indirect calls may not be captured.
A candidate is retained only if it resolves to an actual catalog relation in Production. CTE names and non-relation tokens are therefore excluded.
This file captures schema metadata, not table rows. No user, wallet, order, trade, reservation or transaction row data was read.
The inventory is a timestamped Production snapshot, not an executable schema migration or a substitute for authoritative migration history.
